shortDescription: The Shangai Composite Index fell 21 points or 0.54 percent on Tuesday to close at 3864 points.Leading the losses are BAIC BluePark (-3.82%), Jiangsu Lianyungang (-3.73%) and China Minsheng Bank (-3.23%).Top gainers were Fuyao Glass Indu (2.17%), Zhejiang Zheneng (0.99%) and Baosteel (0.51%).
